content: ADO rate limits (learn.microsoft.com rate-limits, updated 2026-07): global 200 TSTU per sliding 5 min; delays up to 30s then 429 TF400733 when blocked. Headers: Retry-After (seconds), X-RateLimit-Resource, X-RateLimit-Delay, X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset (epoch), X-RateLimit-Cost. Retry-After can arrive on 200 responses; honor it before next request.
